messages:
julia.csm: Heads up — Coriant Labs (acct: COR-421) requested an EU demo next Tue. They need a temporary region pin to eu-west-2 for /cor/v1/respond, add callback CIDR to egress allowlist, and a QPS bump. Can we scope this?
sam-ops: Thanks. Ballpark numbers?
julia.csm: Expect ~450 QPS sustained for ~2.5h, bursts to 700 QPS. TTL requested 48h (start + auto-revoke). They also want header injection: X-Coriant-Env: demo.
nima-net: Please confirm CIDR and whether callbacks are from peered proxy. Header injection at edge is fine but we need the route tag.
julia.csm: CIDR 198.51.100.0/24 from their peered proxy. Route: /cor/v1/respond.
rachel-aml: For demo latency, enable KV cache priming and short warmup for top prompt shapes. I can run a perf eval after the window.
ash-support: Proposed ops plan: 1) create ephemeral policy cor-demo-eu-332345 2) add 198.51.100.0/24 to proxy-egress-allowlist 3) pin route /cor/v1/respond to eu-west-2 4) inject header X-Coriant-Env: demo at edge 5) set qps=450, burst=700, duration=2.5h, ttl=48h 6) canary 3% nodes for 5m -> full roll 7) rollback if error_rate>4% or p95>350ms -> fallback to opt-lite and notify #customer-ops.
sam-ops: +1. Add automatic fallback to opt-lite, notify @oncall on threshold triggers, and enforce token-windowing to avoid spikes.
ash-support: Draft config snippet posted to ops thread (json blob). Scheduling will include canary and rollback hooks.
julia.csm: Note renewal: Coriant upsell window opens in 5 weeks. If the demo drives usage, CS will follow up with an upgrade proposal. Header injection will help attribute traffic.
rachel-aml: I'll enable priming and queue a perf job to validate output quality post-demo.
ash-support: Scheduling and on-call handoff assigned. I'll post roll-back playbook here.
deploy-bot: change cor-demo-eu-332345 created by ash-support. Canary: 3% nodes start: 3323520000 for 5m. Auto-revoke: 48h after start. Rollback thresholds and fallback model configured.
julia.csm: Thanks team — I'll share header docs with Coriant and confirm callback readiness. :rocket:
